svg.title: What the eval changed
svg.desc: 1. The skill's safety rules were too blunt. The first version said "get the user's explicit OK before purchases, posts, submissions, refunds…". The opus-skill refund candidate then stopped and asked for permission, even though the request said "Please refund it", and failed (13/14). The rules are now conditions on the request: do what was asked, ask before consequential actions that are your own idea, and use credentials the request provides. Re-run, the refund passed every time. 2. wait --idle ignored --timeout. An opus-bare candidate's wait --idle ran past two minutes and had to be killed. It's fixed in 2dd2701: it now fails at the timeout with a hint to wait for text or a selector. 3. The harness itself had a bug. One batch gave three reps of a task the same profile. The agents noticed tabs and sign-ins changing under them and moved to scratch profiles on their own, but the batch was discarded and re-run with a profile per run. The lesson went into the docs: parallel agents need separate profiles (or --tab), and cookies on 127.0.0.1 are shared across ports.
